name: Kunszentmiklós (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Kunszentmiklós (a white and red shield with crossed sabres, with a helm, crest and white mantling) above the name KUNSZENTMIKLÓS in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kunszentmiklós arms with helm, crest and mantling
